slides.title: How to reset your life before 2027:
Clean it up
paras: Clean up your space, your phone, your schedule and your circle.
You can't become someone new while living inside the setup of your old self.

slides.title: Own it
paras: Stop waiting for a better season. Be honest about what isn't working in your habits, your money and your days.
Not everything is your fault, but what happens next is on you.
slides.last: Write it down. Pray over it. Move.

slides.title: Put God first
paras: Before the phone. Before the plan.
“But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.” Matthew 6:33

slides.title: Build the routine
paras: Build your days around the life you want: your mornings, your training, your work, your money. Keep showing up when you don't feel like it.

slides.title: This page is for people building a life that honors God.
paras: The System turns all of this into daily quests, streaks and level-ups.
